definitions.full: H1966. helel הֵילֵל Isa 14:12 see below הלל . הִים see הוּם . הֵילֵל noun masculine appellative shining one , epithet of king of Babylon, ה מִשָּׁמַיִם נָפַלְתָּ ׳אֵיךְ בֶּןשָֿׁ֑חַר Isa 14:12 how art thou fallen, shinning one, son of dawn ! i.e. star of the morning. (compare Assyrian muštilil, epithet of (Venus a) morning-star III R Isaiah 57:60 Opp JAS 1871, 448 Schr SK 1874, 337 COT ad. loc .)

occurrences.englishText: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
